description: Update one Google Calendar event: change its title (summary), description, location, or start/end times. Only the fields you pass change; everything else stays. Get the event's id (and its calendar_id, if it isn't on the primary calendar) from get_calendar_events first. Use only when the user asked for the change; edits land on their real calendar immediately, and other attendees can see them. start/end are RFC3339 timestamps ('2026-08-25T19:00:00-04:00').

account.description: Email address of the connected Google account holding the event. Omit to use the account with calendar access.

calendar_id.description: The calendar holding the event (from list_google_calendars). Omit for primary.

name: update_calendar_event
title: Update calendar event
